preJoin.screenShareUnsupported: This browser doesn't support screen sharing — try a different browser.
preJoin.screenShareNoAudio: Screen audio wasn't connected — make sure to enable "Share audio" (Share tab audio) in the picker window. Please try again.
preJoin.screenSharePermissionDenied: Screen sharing permission was denied — it's required for the lesson recording. Please try again.
preJoin.micDisabledTitle: You'll request microphone permission during the lesson
preJoin.deviceErrorMessage: Couldn't connect to the device: {{error}}. Check your browser permissions.
preJoin.micTokenMissing: The server token has no microphone permission — you can't speak in the lesson. This is unexpected, please notify the tech team.
preJoin.teacherScreenShareNote: The browser will ask to share your screen so the lesson can be <0>recorded</0> and <1>shown live</1> to students — pick any section (e.g. "Chrome tab") in the picker and be sure to enable <2>"Share audio"</2> <3>without fail</3> — otherwise sound from your screen (e.g. a video/music) won't reach either the students or the recording. Both the recording and the live view to students start immediately when you join — no need to press anything again. If permission is denied or audio isn't shared, you won't be able to join — you'll need to try again.
preJoin.canChangeLater: You can change this after joining the lesson too.
preJoin.needPermission: You'll need to ask the teacher for permission to speak in the lesson.
preJoin.recordingNote: The lesson is recorded automatically — audio and video
preJoin.mobileRecordingNote: The lesson is recorded — students can watch it later
preJoin.recordingNoteStudent: The lesson is recorded — you can watch it later under “Lesson recording”.
